decision.summary: A sustained multi-axis trend begins at index 570 (N/E up, U down), accelerating after ~600; a brief opposing deviation in U occurs near 620–624 without confirmed return on any axis before end of allowed context (665). The deviation is insufficient to define a complete temporary offset interval; status remains uncertain due to unobserved or ambiguous recovery.

intervals.observation: Sustained monotonic rise in N and E (starting ~570), concurrent with steady U decline; interior shows acceleration after ~600. Near 620–624, U flattens/rises slightly while N/E continue upward—this opposes the dominant trend but lacks a clear return on any axis by 624. No full reversal observed within allowed context.
